entries.title: Claude Fable 5.2 solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
entries.summary: Claude Fable 5.2 has solved two open problems in theoretical physics. Both concern black holes and the search for a theory of quantum gravity.

entries.title: TuringSpace: Grounding Spatial Intelligence in Action with Interactive CAPTCHAs
entries.summary: Humans act in the visual world by inferring the 3D layout behind a 2D view, predicting how an action changes it, and correcting themselves after seeing the result. Can multimodal large language models (MLLMs) do the same?
entries.why: 21 upvotes on HF Papers; also on arXiv cs.LG

entries.title: AltRA-Test: An Alternative Annotator Test for LLM Judges Without Shared Annotators
entries.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges and graders to replace human annotators, raising the question of when such replacement is statistically justified.
entries.why: 14 upvotes on HF Papers; also on arXiv cs.CL

entries.title: Twice-Told Critiques: Claim-Level Homogenization of Peer Review in the LLM Era
entries.summary: Peer review relies on several readers finding different problems. We measure critique overlap in conference and journal reviews.
entries.why: 7 upvotes on HF Papers; also on arXiv cs.CL

entries.title: Accord: Universal Online Metric Localization and Dense Mapping from one Camera and an IMU
entries.summary: Dense metric mapping from a single camera and IMU remains challenging: visual-inertial odometry (VIO) provides metric motion but sparse geometry, whereas feed-forward depth models predict dense structure without ensuring metric scale.
entries.why: 6 upvotes on HF Papers; also on arXiv cs.CV

entries.title: On-Policy Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models
entries.summary: Hybrid attention models combine full and linear attention to achieve a better quality--efficiency trade-off. Converting pretrained Transformers into such models requires identifying which layers should retain full attention under a prescribed budget.
entries.why: 8 upvotes on HF Papers; also on arXiv cs.CL

entries.title: PostgreSQL 19 Released
entries.summary: PostgreSQL 19 Released Most years PostgreSQL ships a new release in September, but this year's release came two months later thanks mainly to the flurry of issues that the PostgreSQL team needed to address as part of the ongoing AI-reported vulnerability apocalypse.
